subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool traces become enabled by default in the full native macOS chat for users who have no stored preference?
rationale: This changes upgrade-visible behavior and potentially exposes detailed assistant activity; source correctness cannot establish the intended product default.

options.title: Preserve the existing default
options.body: Keep traces off unless the user explicitly enables them, while retaining the new persisted toggle.

options.title: Adopt default-on traces
options.body: Intentionally enable traces by default and require explicit upgrade documentation plus native proof showing the resulting experience.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing default
recommendation.body: Keep traces off unless the user explicitly enables them, while retaining the new persisted toggle.

likelyOwner.reason: The project lead and PR author is the strongest available owner for this native-chat product default.
